metadata.title: भूखा सोने को मजबूर पहाड़िया 'आदिम जनजाति' परिवार | Hunger in Paharia Tribe | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: A recent survey published in EPW (Economic and Political Weekly) claims that at least 40 percent of families in Paharia tribe (PVTG) go hungry. This survey is done in 18 villages of two district Palamu and Latehar. Recently Modi government has announced 15K crore rupees for development of PVTG communities.
